{{Top}}
A '''yacht''' was a type of [[Boat/Legends|aquatic vessel]]. Different types were available, such as pleasure yachts or racing yachts. One model, [[Saltech]]'s [[V-53 Hydromancer]] was a pleasure craft; [[Seth Cambriel]] modified his own V-53, the ''[[Cambus Gale]]'', to become a racing yacht.
